text:
Decision: We should build a single, shared “source of truth” document that lists every key term, rule, and constraint we extract from the full transcript and repo, written in plain language with clear examples. This forces us to confront contradictions early and gives everyone—engineers and non-engineers—a place to see the full picture at once.

Trade-off: It slows the first pass down because we have to agree on wording and scope up front, but it saves far more time later by preventing rework and misunderstandings.
